fragments.text: Because of our sins we were exiled from our land and removed from our soil and we are unable to fulfil our duties in the House of Thy choice upon which Thy Name has been called, because of the hand that was stretched out against Thy sanctuary. May it be pleasing to Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, O compassionate King, that Thou mayest again, in Thine abundant mercies, have compassion on us and on Thy sanctuary and rebuild it speedily and add to its glory. Our Father, our King, speedily reveal the glory of Thy Kingdom to us and appear and be exalted over us before the eyes

of all the living. Bring near our dispersed ones from among the nations and collect our scattered ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion, Thy city, in mirth and to Jerusalem the House of Thy sanctuary, in eternal joy. There we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations, the regular offerings according to their order and the additional offerings according to their rule. And the additional offerings of this day of memorial we will prepare and offer up before Thee in love according to the commandment of Thy will as Thou hast written for us in Thy Torah through Moses Thy servant from Thy glorious mouth, saying:
